prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Quantum-Foyer", the grand glass entrance hall of a mega corporation's skyscraper, interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: a vast polished white marble floor with thin glowing cyan inlay lines and soft reflections - this open floor is the large walkable area.
TOP WALL, center: the most eye-catching spot - a huge back wall with a giant glowing round abstract company emblem (a symbol, no letters) in violet and cyan light.
TOP WALL left: a brushed steel elevator door with a fingerprint scanner panel; top wall right: an ornate golden elevator door with a single round button.
TOP LEFT corner: a white staircase with glass railing going up to a gallery, with a small landing at its foot.
RIGHT WALL: from top to bottom a glass elevator door with a velvet rope stand and a small lectern-style guest list pulpit with a screen in front of it, then a swinging service double door with porthole windows (catering), then a plain narrow staff corridor door.
CENTER: a long curved white reception desk with glowing screens and a terminal.
CENTER LEFT: a round floor projector platform with a ring of light, a giant translucent hologram glow rising from it (abstract, faceless shimmering shape, not a person).
LEFT WALL: a security office as a glass cube with monitor walls and a radio set on a desk inside; lower left a small lost-and-found counter with shelves of boxes and a service bell.
LOWER RIGHT: a sleek white waiting bench, a promotional stand with a white counter and a small glowing display, and in the bottom right corner a glowing food vending machine.
BOTTOM CENTER: a big revolving glass door (the way out).
Small stuff at the edges: tall potted plants, chrome bollards with ropes, a cleaning robot dock, drawn small so they don't hide the floor.
Light: indoor, cold clean white light, cyan glow, violet from the emblem, a little gold from the golden elevator.
